title: Tacos
incredients: Corn or flour tortillas, chicken or beef, onions, tomatoes, lettuce, cheese, spices, oil, and lime.
recipe: The meat is cooked in oil with spices until tender and flavorful. Tortillas are warmed on a pan, filled with the cooked meat, topped with fresh vegetables and cheese, then finished with a squeeze of lime before serving hot.

title: Empanadas Mexicanas
desc: Sealed, fried, and full of flavor
incredients: Flour dough, meat or vegetable filling, spices, oil, and salt.
recipe: Dough is rolled into discs and filled with seasoned filling. The edges are sealed, and empanadas are deep-fried until golden and crisp before serving.

title: Sopes
incredients: Corn masa dough, refried beans, meat, lettuce, cheese, salsa, oil, and salt.
recipe: Corn masa is shaped into small thick discs and cooked on a hot pan, then lightly fried until firm. The edges are pinched to hold toppings. Refried beans are spread on top, followed by cooked meat, lettuce, cheese, and salsa before serving warm.

title: Gorditas
incredients: Corn masa, salt, meat or vegetables, cheese, oil, and salsa.
recipe: Masa dough is shaped into thick rounds and cooked on a griddle. The gorditas are sliced open, filled with cooked meat or vegetables and cheese, then lightly fried again before serving with salsa.

title: Molletes
incredients: Bolillo bread, refried beans, cheese, butter, and pico de gallo.
recipe: Bread is sliced and lightly buttered, then topped with refried beans and cheese. It is baked until the cheese melts and finished with fresh pico de gallo before serving.

title: Flautas
incredients: Corn tortillas, shredded chicken or beef, oil, lettuce, cheese, and cream.
recipe: ortillas are filled with meat, rolled tightly, and deep-fried until golden and crispy. They are topped with lettuce, cheese, and cream before serving.

title: Sincronizadas
incredients: Flour tortillas, ham, cheese, butter, and salsa.
recipe: One tortilla is topped with cheese and ham, covered with another tortilla, and cooked on a pan with butter until the cheese melts and both sides turn golden.

title: Chilaquiles
incredients: Fried tortilla chips, red or green salsa, cheese, cream, onions, and oil.
recipe: Tortilla chips are lightly fried and tossed in warm salsa until slightly softened. The dish is topped with cheese, cream, and onions and served immediately.

title: Alambre
incredients: Beef or chicken, bacon, bell peppers, onions, cheese, oil, and spices.
recipe: Bacon is cooked until crisp, then meat is added and cooked thoroughly. Vegetables are sautéed with spices, everything is mixed together, topped with cheese, and served hot.

title: Pambazo
incredients: Pambazo bread, potatoes, chorizo, chili sauce, cheese, oil, and lettuce.
recipe: Bread is dipped in chili sauce and lightly fried. A filling of potatoes and chorizo is added inside, then topped with cheese and lettuce before serving warm.

title: Tlacoyos
incredients: Blue corn masa, beans or cheese filling, oil, lettuce, salsa, and cheese.
recipe: Masa is filled with beans or cheese, shaped into ovals, and cooked on a hot pan. They are topped with lettuce, salsa, and cheese before serving.
